title: Under Armour Debuts We Love Football Campaign
summary: Under Armour is celebrating the sport where the brand began with, We Love Football, a season-long content platform celebrating the passion that make football one of America's most beloved sports.
body_markdown:
Content throughout the season will feature some of the sport's most recognizable names, including Notre Dame Football Head Coach Marcus Freeman, NFL athletes such as Justin Jefferson, Zay Flowers, DeVonta Smith, Nick Emmanwori, and USA Football athletes such as Ashlea Klam and Makena Cook. Together, they reflect the passion, commitment and sense of community that continue to shape the game.


We Love Football will roll out across Under Armour’s social and digital channels throughout the 2026 NFL season through episodic storytelling and athlete-led social content.
